rules: Treat the v003 1943H2 settlement, Bengal/Chittagong settlement, GALVANIC v003 final negative-delta settlement and Dodecanese withdrawal as realized current Branch B history.
Do not import any realized combat event after 1943-12-31 from retained/provisional descendants unless explicitly re-adjudicated from this frontier.
Late-December British Eastern Fleet eastbound movement/potential may be used only to the extent explicitly stated; January arrival/contact/combat remains open.
All 1944 capability must remain date-gated: hull existence, readiness, personnel, allocation, fuel, escort, route and local support are separate clocks.
No unit spawning and no fleet teleportation. Every cross-theater move requires origin, readiness, route, transit and arrival state.
Japanese destroyer/submarine/cruiser Indian Ocean reinforcement is NOT yet allocated; audit the movable wallet first.
German Monsun/U-boat cooperation requires actual boat availability and patrol days; no nominal-total shortcut.
No U-Go GO has been issued at this frontier; Ichigo and Central Pacific 1944 dates remain planning baselines, not realized fate.

GALVANIC v001 is comparison/provenance only. Never restore Liscome Bay sinking, Cowpens campaign-out, light-only Lexington damage, undamaged Soryu, or the historical 12/4 mass Kwajalein/Roi raid from retained descendants.

At 1944-01-01: Independence and Lexington are unavailable in major repair pipelines; Yorktown/Cowpens/Liscome Bay are operational; Soryu is alive but unavailable in home-yard repair; Shokaku/Zuikaku/Hiryu are operational.
Carrier-air strength and trained-strike-cadre strength are separate. Japan retains substantial aircraft/deck depth but has a real experienced attack-leadership/navigation debt after 11/26.

Kinsei Zero is date-gated through AIRCRAFT_FIELDING_LEDGER_1943-10-01_v003 plus the 1943-11 GALVANIC event fielding gate; do not freeze it at zero after 1943-10-01 and do not back-port full 1944 production.

GALVANIC no-change nodes are valid only under the 2026-08-29 negative-delta audit. If a future upstream correction touches a threshold path, re-open that specific node rather than restoring an old outcome.
